title: CPSC, Lillian Vernon Corporation Announce Recall of Costumes
summary: Fabric used in these costumes can ignite readily and presents a serious risk of burn injuries, in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Units: About 2,900.

title: CPSC, The Grasshopper Company Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: The fuel tank could leak gasoline, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: 174.

title: CPSC, WCI Outdoor Products Inc. Announce Recall of Lawn Tractors
summary: The tank in the lawn tractor can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 35,000.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corporation, U.S.A. Announce Recall of Motocross Motorcycles
summary: The throttle on these motorcycles can stick, causing a rider to lose control of the vehicle and crash, resulting in injuries and death. Units: About 59,100.

title: CPSC, Hamilton Beach Announce Recall of Juice Extractors
summary: The juice extractor's strainer basket and lid can break apart, posing a risk of injury to nearby consumers, who can be struck by metal or plastic. Units: About 2.4 million.

title: CPSC, JA-RU Inc. Announce Recall of "Blast Balls" Toys
summary: When struck together, the toys create a cracking sound similar to that of a cap gun. The directions instruct consumers to strike one ball against the other in the palm of hand, to create the cracking sound. title: CPSC, Suzuki Motor Corporation Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The nut that secures the LT-F400K2 and LT-F400FK2 clutch shoe will come loose during operation. When the nut loosens, the clutch shoe will become loose on the crankshaft. title: CPSC, BikeE Announce Recall of Recumbent Tandem Bicycle
summary: The steerer tube on the front forks can separate, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall, and possibly suffer serious injuries. Units: 700.

title: CPSC, Pacific Cycle, LLC Announce Recall to Repair Ally Cat Tandem Bicycle Accessories
summary: The hitch connecting the tandem accessory to the host bicycle can fail, causing the tandem accessory to become unstable, which poses the risk of injury to riders. Units: About 2,500.

title: CPSC, Performance Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Rims
summary: The rims can crack, causing the rider to lose control of the bicycle, fall and suffer injuries. Units: 1,150.

title: CPSC, Computer Distributors Announce Recall of Batteries for Notebook Computers
summary: These batteries can overcharge during re-charging, causing them to overheat, smoke and possibly catch fire. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Sears Announce Recall of Electric Chain Saws and Electric Edgers
summary: The plug at the end of the power cord of the chain saw and the edger may have exposed copper wires, presenting a possible electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,100.

title: CPSC, Candlewick Press Announce Recall of Children's Board Books
summary: The plastic lamination on the board book may peel off, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: 78,670.

title: CPSC, Progress Lighting Announce Recall of Fluorescent Lights
summary: The lights are improperly wired, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,600.

title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Co., Inc. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: Some wheels have not been properly welded. The wheel could collapse while riding, possibly resulting in serious injury. Units: About 14,400.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Corporation Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: There may be an inadequate weld on the front upper A-arm bracket. If the upper A-arm bracket separates from the frame, the rider could lose control of the vehicle and be seriously injured. Units: About 550.

title: CPSC, Alco Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Water Fountains With Candle Holders
summary: The tea candles on the water fountains can flare up, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: 75,000.

title: CPSC, Darice Inc. Announce Recall of Candle Holders
summary: When the candle burns down to the bottom of the wick, it can set the candle holder on fire, which poses fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: 60,000.

title: CPSC, Profile-Design LLC Announce Recall of Bicycle "Aero Bars"
summary: The brackets that attach the aero bars' forearm pads, where riders rest their arms, can loosen or separate during use, causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 8,400.

title: CPSC, Aqua-Leisure Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Inflatable Baby Floats
summary: The leg holes in the seat of the float can tear, causing children to unexpectedly fall into the water and possibly drown. Units: About 90,000.

title: CPSC, HandsOnToys, Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Rattles
summary: The rattle can break and expose the noisemaker inside the rattle handle, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, KB Gear Announce Recall of Computer Mouse Sets
summary: The mouse ball can separate from the mouse and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 49,000.

title: CPSC, Manley Toy Direct Announce the Recall of Zapper Toys
summary: The balloon tongues and the cylinders holding the tongues on these toys can detach, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 15,800.

title: CPSC, Stride Rite Children's Group Inc. Announce Recall of Girls' Shoes
summary: The buckle on these shoes can break, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 109,000.

title: CPSC, Ceraflame Inc. Announce Recall of Ceramic Tea Kettles
summary: The tea kettles can break or burst during use, spilling hot water, which poses the risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Gevalia Coffee Announce Recall of Coffeemakers
summary: Coffeemakers can overflow, presenting a serious risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: Screws in the ATV's manual transmission can loosen, causing the rear wheels to lock. This can cause the driver to lose control of the ATV and crash, possibly resulting in injury or death. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Raleigh America Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles
summary: The bottom bracket spindle inside the crankset of the bicycle can break, causing the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 500.
